basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old software developer based in Austin, Texas. I recently started exploring personal finance and investing, which led me to join Reddit. I'm particularly interested in ETFs and the Bogleheads investing philosophy. I enjoy cooking, particularly trying out new recipes, and I'm an amateur butterfly knife enthusiast. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work. I'm currently single and enjoy spending time with friends during the weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in computer science and have been working in the tech industry for 7 years. My interest in investing began recently, spurred by discussions with colleagues and online research. I've been actively learning through books and forums like Bogleheads.
